blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The witness presented by Vice President Sara Duterte’s camp to dispute allegations of unusual credit card spending has admitted being close to her and her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, and regularly receiving compensation from the couple for his legal services. During Duterte’s impeachment trial on Thursday, lawyer Anel Antero was questioned by prosecution counsel Amando Virgil Ligutan about his closeness to the vice president and her husband, apparently to scrutinize his credibility as a defense witness.
